scene.frogtown_anchor: Los Angeles River bicycle path with concrete river edge, riparian plants, and distant bridge structure
scene.starting_composition: all four animals appear together in a readable staggered group near the lower middle of the portrait frame
scene.required_action: the complete group advances several visible steps along the path; legs, bodies, heads, tails, wings, and spacing change coherently
scene.ending_composition: the four remain present and recognizable in a slightly changed formation farther along the path
scene.camera: restrained lateral tracking may follow the group but cannot be the primary source of motion
scene.environmental_motion: river glint, two or three plant movements, and a distant bicycle-wheel arc reinforce forward travel

camera: restrained lateral drift that never becomes the primary source of motion
subject_motion: coherent limb cycles and shifting body weight
environmental_motion: river glint and plant sway supporting forward travel

continuity_invariants: exactly one unicorn, one albatross, one dog, and one cat
cat flank circle and high curved tail
off-white, black, cyan, chartreuse, magenta, yellow, and coral palette
no species swaps, duplication, disappearance, or extra limbs
Frogtown and Los Angeles River specificity
actual animal locomotion rather than camera drift
no spike-shaped projection on any animal back or body; cat back and high curved tail stay clean and continuous
prompt: Animate the supplied accepted Frogtown keyframe as an original two-dimensional graphic scene. Keep exactly one unicorn, one albatross, one dog, and one cat, with the same readable silhouettes and restrained neon markings. Over five seconds, the four animals walk together along the Frogtown Los Angeles River bicycle path. Show coherent leg cycles, shifting body weight, head turns, tail and wing balance, and changing spacing. The albatross walks and makes one low balancing hop rather than flying away. Track laterally with restraint while river glints, riparian plants, and one distant bicycle-wheel arc move independently. Preserve bold off-white and black fields, cyan, chartreuse, magenta, yellow, and coral accents, tactile ink and paper texture, angular shadow, and generous negative space. End with all four animals intact and farther along the same recognizable path. No text and no audio.
negative_prompt: spike-shaped projection on any animal back
review_questions: Do all four animals make unmistakable body-driven forward progress?
Does each character retain its species, silhouette, and restrained markings?
Does the setting read as Frogtown beside the Los Angeles River?
Does environmental motion support rather than replace the group walk?
Is the motion calm enough to support conversation in later shots?
